name: @cbartens/bkit
description: Agent-stack consolidation CLI — distributed via GitHub Packages npm registry (@cbartens:registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com).

scripts.bkit:gate:static: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint:prose && pnpm slop:delta
scripts.bkit:gate:static-unit: pnpm bkit:gate:static && pnpm test && pnpm test:coverage:unit && pnpm bkit:test:bats
scripts.bkit:gate:install-static-unit-build: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm bkit:gate:static-unit && pnpm build
scripts.lint: bash -c 'if [ -f eslint.config.js ] || [ -f eslint.config.mjs ] || [ -f .eslintrc.json ]; then npx eslint .; else echo "[bkit] no eslint config - skipping lint (bkit typechecks with tsc and scans with slop-scan)"; fi'
scripts.lint:prose: bash -c 'if command -v vale >/dev/null 2>&1; then if [ ! -d .vale/styles/write-good ]; then echo "[bkit] .vale/styles/write-good absent (fresh checkout or worktree) - restoring" >&2; G=$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null) && M=$(dirname "$(cd "$G" && pwd)") && [ -d "$M/.vale/styles/write-good" ] && mkdir -p .vale/styles && cp -R "$M/.vale/styles/write-good" .vale/styles/ || vale sync || true; fi; if [ -d .vale/styles/write-good ]; then FILES=$(find .agents -maxdepth 1 -name "*.md"; find .bkit -maxdepth 1 -name "*.md" 2>/dev/null; find .bkit/workflows .bkit/prompts -name "*.md" 2>/dev/null; find docs -maxdepth 1 -name "*.md" 2>/dev/null; find .bkit/templates/docs -name "*.md" 2>/dev/null; find . -maxdepth 1 -name "*.md"); vale $FILES; else echo "[bkit] WARNING - PROSE LINT SKIPPED: vale is installed but .vale/styles/write-good could not be restored (main-worktree copy and vale sync both failed). The prose gate is NOT enforcing here - run: vale sync" >&2; fi; else echo "[bkit] vale not installed - skipping prose lint (install vale, then run vale sync, to enable)"; fi'
scripts.bkit:lint:workflows: bash -c 'if command -v actionlint >/dev/null 2>&1; then actionlint; else echo "[bkit] actionlint missing — skipping workflow lint (install actionlint to enable)"; fi'
scripts.bkit:test:bats: bash -c 'if command -v bats >/dev/null 2>&1; then bats tests/*.bats; else echo "[bkit] bats missing - skipping bats suite (install bats to enable)" >&2; fi'
scripts.bkit:check:dist: rm -rf dist && tsc && chmod +x dist/bkit-install.js && git diff --exit-code dist/ || (echo '[bkit] dist/ is stale — run pnpm build and commit the result' && exit 1)
